note: Tempo's pages, included by music-player.screen.json: the main view that scrolls them (by hand, so the bar above a playlist and its column titles can stay), and home, search, a genre, a playlist, an album, the liked songs, an artist, a podcast and the lyrics.

computed.pageColor: {{state.view.page == 'playlist' ? state.playlists[state.view.i].color : state.view.page == 'album' ? state.albums[state.view.i].color : state.view.page == 'artist' ? state.artists[state.view.i].color : state.view.page == 'show' ? state.shows[state.view.i].color : state.view.page == 'genre' ? state.genres[state.view.i].color : state.view.page == 'liked' ? '#4527a0' : state.view.page == 'lyrics' ? computed.curAlbum.color : '#3b2a7a'}}
computed.pageName: {{state.view.page == 'playlist' ? state.playlists[state.view.i].name : state.view.page == 'album' ? state.albums[state.view.i].title : state.view.page == 'artist' ? state.artists[state.view.i].name : state.view.page == 'show' ? state.shows[state.view.i].name : state.view.page == 'genre' ? state.genres[state.view.i].name : t('liked')}}
computed.homeShelves: {{filter([{ key: 'made', title: t('home.made'), items: map(slice(range(12), 6), { kind: 'playlist', i: it, img: state.playlists[it].cover, title: state.playlists[it].name, sub: state.playlists[it].description }), kind: 'music' }, { key: 'recent', title: t('home.recent'), items: map(slice(computed.recents, 0, 10), { kind: it.kind, i: it.i, img: it.img, title: it.name, sub: it.sub, round: it.round }), kind: 'music' }, { key: 'back', title: t('home.back'), items: map(range(length(state.albums)), { kind: 'album', i: it, img: state.albums[it].cover, title: state.albums[it].title, sub: state.albums[it].year + ' · ' + state.albums[it].artist }), kind: 'music' }, { key: 'artists', title: t('home.artists'), items: map(range(length(state.artists)), { kind: 'artist', i: it, img: state.artists[it].image, title: state.artists[it].name, sub: t('lib.artist'), round: true }), kind: 'music' }, { key: 'shows', title: t('home.shows'), items: map(range(length(state.shows)), { kind: 'show', i: it, img: state.shows[it].cover, title: state.shows[it].name, sub: state.shows[it].publisher }), kind: 'podcasts' }], state.homeKind == 'all' || it.kind == state.homeKind)}}
computed.found: {{state.query == '' ? {} : { tracks: map(fuzzySort(map(state.tracks, { s: it.title + ' ' + it.artist }), state.query, 's', 20), it.index), artists: map(fuzzySort(state.artists, state.query, 'name', 10), it.index), albums: map(fuzzySort(state.albums, state.query, 'title', 10), it.index), playlists: map(fuzzySort(state.playlists, state.query, 'name', 10), it.index) }}}
computed.topResult: {{state.query == '' ? null : length(computed.found.artists) > 0 ? { kind: 'artist', i: computed.found.artists[0], img: state.artists[computed.found.artists[0]].image, title: state.artists[computed.found.artists[0]].name, sub: t('lib.artist'), round: true } : length(computed.found.albums) > 0 ? { kind: 'album', i: computed.found.albums[0], img: state.albums[computed.found.albums[0]].cover, title: state.albums[computed.found.albums[0]].title, sub: t('lib.album') + ' · ' + state.albums[computed.found.albums[0]].artist } : length(computed.found.playlists) > 0 ? { kind: 'playlist', i: computed.found.playlists[0], img: state.playlists[computed.found.playlists[0]].cover, title: state.playlists[computed.found.playlists[0]].name, sub: t('lib.playlist') + ' · ' + state.playlists[computed.found.playlists[0]].owner } : null}}
computed.searchShelves: {{filter([{ key: 'sArtists', kind: 'artists', title: t('search.artists'), items: map(computed.found.artists, { kind: 'artist', i: it, img: state.artists[it].image, title: state.artists[it].name, sub: t('lib.artist'), round: true }) }, { key: 'sAlbums', kind: 'albums', title: t('search.albums'), items: map(computed.found.albums, { kind: 'album', i: it, img: state.albums[it].cover, title: state.albums[it].title, sub: state.albums[it].year + ' · ' + state.albums[it].artist }) }, { key: 'sPlaylists', kind: 'playlists', title: t('search.playlists'), items: map(computed.found.playlists, { kind: 'playlist', i: it, img: state.playlists[it].cover, title: state.playlists[it].name, sub: t('lib.by', { name: state.playlists[it].owner }) }) }], length(it.items) > 0 && (state.searchKind == 'all' || state.searchKind == it.kind))}}
computed.pageH: {{computed.isTable ? 472 + 56 * length(computed.rows) + (state.view.page == 'album' ? 120 + computed.shelfH : 48) : state.view.page == 'artist' ? 508 + 56 * length(computed.popular) + 64 + 112 + computed.cardW + 64 + 64 + 420 + computed.shelfH + 32 : state.view.page == 'home' ? 116 + ceil(length(computed.shortcuts) / computed.shortcutCols) * 64 + 16 + length(computed.homeShelves) * computed.shelfH + 24 : state.view.page == 'search' ? (state.query == '' ? 80 + ceil(length(state.genres) / computed.cols) * (computed.tileH + 16) + 24 : state.searchKind == 'songs' ? 64 + 56 * length(computed.found.tracks) + 24 : 64 + 300 + length(computed.searchShelves) * computed.shelfH + 24) : state.view.page == 'genre' ? 240 + 2 * computed.shelfH + 32 : state.view.page == 'show' ? 428 + 64 + 120 * length(state.shows[state.view.i].episodes) + 32 : state.view.page == 'lyrics' ? 160 + 56 * length(computed.lyrics) + 200 : 0}}

sortBy.note: with: by. A column title sorts by it, then the other way round, then back to the playlist's order

sortBy.to: {{state.sort.by != by ? { by: by, desc: false } : !state.sort.desc ? { by: by, desc: true } : { by: '', desc: false }}}

pick.note: with: n (a row) and event: a click picks the row, Cmd or Ctrl adds it, Shift picks the rows up to it

moveRow.note: with: from, to (rows of the playlist open): the song dragged from one place to the other

moveRow.to: {{concat(slice(filter(computed.rows, index != from), 0, to), [computed.rows[from]], slice(filter(computed.rows, index != from), to))}}

card.note: A playlist, album, artist or podcast on a shelf: its cover (round for an artist), a play button on hover, its name and a line under it

shelf.note: A titled row of cards with Show all and arrows that move it a screenful at a time

tableHead.note: The column titles of a song table; a click sorts by the column

pageHeader.note: The coloured top of a playlist, album, podcast or artist without a banner: the cover, the kind, the big name and a line of details

actionBar.note: The row under a page's header: the big play button, shuffle, save, more

trackRow.note: A song in a playlist, album or artist table; n is its row

with.label: {{pl != null ? t('lib.playlist') : al != null ? t('album.' + lower(al.kind)) : t('lib.playlist')}}
with.details: {{pl != null ? pl.owner + (pl.saves > 0 ? ' • ' + t('page.saves', { n: formatNumber(pl.saves) }) : '') : al != null ? al.artist + ' • ' + al.year : 'Robin'}} • {{t('lib.songs', { n: length(computed.rows) })}}, {{t('page.duration', { h: floor(computed.totalTime / 3600), m: floor(computed.totalTime / 60) % 60 })}}

with.saved: {{pl != null ? contains(state.saved, state.view.i) : al != null ? contains(state.savedAlbums, state.view.i) : true}}

with.items: {{map(filter(range(length(state.albums)), state.albums[it].artist == al.artist && it != state.view.i), { kind: 'album', i: it, img: state.albums[it].cover, title: state.albums[it].title, sub: state.albums[it].year + ' · ' + state.albums[it].kind })}}
